system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant for commerce and subscription setup tasks.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Create a product and a monthly billing plan, then activate it.

prompts.prompt_text: Hi, I'm Ms. Eliza Taylor. Can you set up a new product for my online Python class with the name "Python course" and make it purchasable as a monthly plan (20.00 USD to be paid every month)?

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products WHERE name = 'Python course'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans bp JOIN products p ON p.id = bp.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Python course' AND bp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND json_extract(bp.billing_cycles, '$[0].frequency.interval_unit') = 'MONTH' AND json_extract(bp.billing_cycles, '$[0].frequency.interval_count') = 1 AND json_extract(bp.billing_cycles, '$[0].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.value') = '20.00' AND json_extract(bp.billing_cycles, '$[0].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.currency_code') = 'USD'
